metadata.title: Metric Cup to Milliliters Converter
metadata.description: Convert metric cups to milliliters (mL) with a fixed 1 metric cup = 250 mL factor, plus guidance on rounding and measurement context.

introduction: Use this converter when a recipe or specification cites metric cups and you need the volume in milliliters.
This tool assumes the metric cup definition of exactly 250 mL per cup.
methodology: We apply the fixed relationship: 1 metric cup = 250 milliliters.
For high-precision needs, rely on calibrated volumetric instruments; this converter provides the direct numeric conversion.
how_is_calculated: Primary formula: milliliters = metric cups x 250
Example steps: enter cups, multiply by 250, then round based on required precision.

faqs.question: What definition of cup is used here?
faqs.answer: This converter uses the metric cup (250 mL). If you need US or imperial/UK cups, use the corresponding converters.

faqs.question: How should I round the result?
faqs.answer: Round based on your application: kitchen use often rounds to the nearest 1-5 mL; lab work should follow significant-figure rules.
